name: code-token-typeset
title: Code Token Typeset
description: Inline code typeset as a first-class citizen: a tiny tokenizer (keywords, strings, comments, numbers) renders spans with typographic detail most highlighters skip — tabular numerals, zero-width joiners and per-token kerning fixes.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Dense
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Monospace
Color: Duotone

## Rules

- Static: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
